title: nageia palembanica
intro: Nageia palembanica, commonly known as Palemban Nageia, is a plant species in the conifer family (Podocarpaceae). This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Nageia palembanica include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can aid in the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities.
